basic_details.job_title: NALCO Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Specialist & Medical Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO) Medical Officer & Specialist Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 20 July 2026 on the official website nalcoindia.com. A total of 6 vacancies have been announced through the NALCO Medical Officer & Specialist Recruitment 2026 for Medical Officer and Specialist (Orthopedic, Radiology & Ophthalmology) posts.

application_fee.details: There is no application fee for any category of candidates applying for the Medical Officer and Specialist posts.

age_limit.details: Specialist (E03 grade): Maximum 38 years as on 17/08/2026 Medical Officer & Specialist (E02 grade): Maximum 35 years as on 17/08/2026 Internal candidates on the immediate lower scale of pay: No upper age limit, subject to Company Rules Age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC(NCL), 10 years for PwBD-UR, 13 years for PwBD-OBC(NCL), 15 years for PwBD-SC/ST candidates Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) is subject to availability of a post in that particular category Ex-servicemen and family members of those who died in the 1984 riots will get relaxation as per Government of India directives Maximum upper age of any applicant shall not exceed 56 years, including all possible age relaxations

salary_details.details: The Medical Officer (E02) and Specialist (E02) posts carry a pay scale of ₹70,000-3%-2,00,000, while the Specialist (E03) post carries a pay scale of ₹80,000-3%-2,20,000. how_to_apply: Visit the official NALCO website, www.nalcoindia.com
Go to the career section and locate the Medical Officer & Specialist Recruitment 2026 notification
Read the detailed advertisement carefully before proceeding
Fill in the online application form with accurate information
Upload the required photograph, signature, and self-attested documents
Review all entered details carefully, as no changes are allowed after final submission
Submit the application online before 17/08/2026 (06:00 PM)
Keep a copy of the submitted application and documents for future reference; hard copies need not be sent by post

Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Applications received through any mode other than online will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. A candidate can be considered for one post only; applying for more than one post will lead to cancellation of candidature.
important_instructions: No request for change in any data entered by the candidate will be entertained once the online application is submitted successfully Submission of wrong information will lead to rejection through computer-based shortlisting No enquiry seeking advice on eligibility criteria will be entertained The candidate's registered e-mail ID must remain valid for one year, as all future communication will be through e-mail only Candidates working in PSUs/Government organizations should generally apply through proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview; otherwise, joining (if selected) will be allowed only after a formal release order from the present employer Original certificates, mark sheets, and other relevant documents must be produced if called for a Personal Interview All computation of age, experience, and qualification will be done with reference to 17/08/2026 Candidates called for interview (E2 & E3 grades) will be reimbursed IInd class AC (Sleeper) to-and-fro train/bus fare from their communication address by the shortest route, on production of tickets; no change in communication address will be entertained later for reimbursement purposes NALCO reserves the right to fill or not fill any position, and to cancel, restrict, modify or alter the recruitment process, or increase/decrease the number of posts, without assigning any reason Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate's candidature Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Cuttack, Odisha only

Candidates who have completed their MBBS or MD/MS degree can also explore more MBBS Government Jobs and Medical Officer Jobs available across India. Applicants looking for more PSU opportunities can also check the latest Navratna PSU Jobs 2026 and Odisha Government Jobs. content_sections.heading: NALCO Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: NALCO has announced 6 vacancies for Medical Officer and Specialist posts, distributed across the following categories: Note: The number of posts is tentative and may vary depending on the Company's existing and future organizational requirements.

content_sections.heading: NALCO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is assessed as on 17/08/2026. Candidates who have been in self-practice must upload their valid medical registration along with the registration of the clinic or nursing home for the relevant period, while providing details of their experience. All qualifications must be from a UGC-recognised Indian University/Deemed University or AICTE-approved courses from autonomous institutions/the concerned statutory council. Where CGPA/OGPA or a letter grade is awarded, candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage as per norms adopted by their University/Institute and attach documentary proof.

rows.qualification: MBBS. PG Certificate in Industrial Health approved by DGFASLI preferred.
rows.experience: 4 completed years of post-qualification experience as a doctor in Govt./PSU or a reputed/leading hospital/organization

rows.qualification: MD/MS/Recognized post-MBBS Diploma in the respective discipline
MD/MS/Recognized post-MBBS Diploma in the respective discipline
rows.experience: 3 completed years of post MD/MS/Recognized Diploma experience as a specialist doctor in Govt./PSU or a reputed/leading hospital/organization

content_sections.heading: NALCO Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Specialist (E03 grade): Maximum 38 years as on 17/08/2026 Medical Officer & Specialist (E02 grade): Maximum 35 years as on 17/08/2026 Internal candidates on the immediate lower scale of pay: No upper age limit, subject to Company Rules Age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC(NCL), 10 years for PwBD-UR, 13 years for PwBD-OBC(NCL), 15 years for PwBD-SC/ST candidates Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) is subject to availability of a post in that particular category Ex-servicemen and family members of those who died in the 1984 riots will get relaxation as per Government of India directives Maximum upper age of any applicant shall not exceed 56 years, including all possible age relaxations

content_sections.heading: NALCO Medical Officer & Specialist Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: The Medical Officer (E02) and Specialist (E02) posts carry a pay scale of ₹70,000-3%-2,00,000, while the Specialist (E03) post carries a pay scale of ₹80,000-3%-2,20,000. In addition to Basic Pay and DA as per the Industrial DA pattern, selected candidates will receive Perks (35% of basic pay), Non-Practicing Allowance (20% of basic pay), Performance Related Pay based on Company and individual performance, Company accommodation or HRA, medical facilities for self and dependent family members, Post-Retirement Medical Benefit, Leave Encashment, Pension as per NPS, Contributory Provident Fund, Group Insurance, and Gratuity, as per Company Rules.

content_sections.heading: NALCO Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for any category of candidates applying for the Medical Officer and Specialist posts.

content_sections.heading: NALCO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting is done based on the information/declaration submitted by the candidate at the time of online application submission If any false declaration is found during document/experience verification at the time of the Personal Interview, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview, and no TA will be paid Assessment is made through Personal Interview only Selection is based on interview performance, organizational requirement, and vacancies to be operated Meeting the advertised eligibility criteria alone does not entitle a candidate to be called for a Personal Interview; NALCO reserves the right to raise minimum eligibility standards to restrict the number of candidates for assessment

content_sections.heading: NALCO Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Recent passport-size colour photograph Signature Self-attested scanned copy of qualification proofs Proof related to experience Recent salary slip Document related to the existing employer or a copy of Form 16/annual IT return Valid SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificate, if applicable, in the prescribed Government of India format (self-attested translated copy in English/Hindi if issued in another language) PwBD disability certificate as per the format prescribed by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (notification no. G.S.R. 591(E) dated 15.06.2017), where applicable
